Mercury |Δr|: heliocentric, max over the common output times, against the scenario's reference run in this same harness invocation (REBOUND for (a); FerroAstro for (b) and (d)).

Perihelion rates: the WP14/WP17 Park2017 estimator (sampled-state passages, Park17 mean-orbit plane, quadratic + 14 Table-2 terms with SW92 T2A mean motions, 20 jack-knife blocks), window epoch + 30 d to end − 30 d, applied to each tool's daily twin (CI-009).

(a) Sun + 8 planets, Newtonian, 1000 yr: estimator Park2017 (NUM-011): heliocentric perihelion passages (r.v = 0 rising, Lagrange-interpolated samples), perihelion direction referred to a fixed reference plane; longitude projected: angle of the passage position projected on the reference plane; plane Mercury mean-orbit frame (Park et al. 2017): plane normal to pole RA 280.9876 deg, Dec 61.4481 deg (ICRF); y = z x X_ICRF, x = y x z; fit B + varpi_dot*t + Q*t^2 + sum_i (S_i sin nu_i t + C_i cos nu_i t), 14 frequencies [0nM + 2nV (SW92 T2A), 0nM + 1nV (SW92 T2A), 1nM - 2nV (SW92 T2A), 2nM - 3nV (SW92 T2A), 1nM - 3nV (SW92 T2A), 2nM - 4nV (SW92 T2A), 2nM - 5nV (SW92 T2A), 1nM - 2nE (SW92 T2A), 1nM - 4nE (SW92 T2A), 0nM + 3nJ (SW92 T2A), 0nM + 2nJ (SW92 T2A), 0nM + 1nJ (SW92 T2A), 1nM - 2nJ (SW92 T2A), 0nM + 2nS (SW92 T2A)]; t in Julian centuries from J2000.0 TDB; unweighted least squares (Householder QR); 20 jack-knife blocks; passages located in the sampled relative states (Lagrange interpolant); Lagrange order 8; passages in JD 2440430.5 .. 2805620.5 TDB; body Mercury relative to Sun
